gameName: Sherlock Holmes Consulting Detective: The Thames Murders & Other Cases
firstPlayerRule: Choose a lead investigator. That player reads the case introduction and takes the first turn, choosing a lead to investigate.
clarifications: After reading one lead, pass the booklet to the player on the left, who becomes the next lead investigator. The group may discuss freely; the current lead investigator decides if players disagree about the next destination.
